_: Controls under 44x44 INSIDE each sheet, MEASURED. Same ratchet as touch-targets.baseline.json: a number may only go DOWN, and the audit fails if one climbs or if one falls without this file being tightened.
_why: touch-targets.mjs loads the 21 screens and measures what is ON them. Nothing inside a sheet, dialog or bottom sheet had ever been measured — New Sale, the product picker, the GRN dialog, Edit SKU, every confirm. That is where money is entered, and it is why a 36px Pack/Carton pill sat in front of Ali on the day he was told every control was 44px.
_first_run: MEASURED by CI on 2026-09-02. All four sheets open. What the first real look inside them found, none of it reachable by the screen sweep because none of it is on a screen: New Sale's close button at 17x28; TWENTY controls at 16px tall on New SKU (the category chips); SIX on the Sosoft sheet, where a bottle, a mixed carton and a whole carton are chosen. 27 in total. The product type sheet is clean.
_2026_09_02_the_step_from_the_screenshot: The plain product step — the picker, and one diaper chosen — was recorded here as NOT COVERED, because three CI rounds were spent guessing at a selector that would open it. That was the wrong fix: the step Ali photographed a 36px pill on stayed the one step no audit could reach. The real cause was that the product card had no accessible name, so nothing could address it — a VoiceOver defect as much as a test one. The card has one now, and both steps are driven. What a grep found on them before CI ever ran: the quick-add + at 36x36 (the same size as the pill in his screenshot), two Change buttons at 32px, and the cross-sell dismiss at 32x32. All four are 44 now.
_provisional: sale-products and sale-product are set to 40 DELIBERATELY, not measured. Setting a new baseline to 0 without knowing what is on the screen is exactly the guess CI caught on new-sku, where six more controls were hiding underneath. The audit fails when a number comes in BELOW its baseline and prints the real one, so this generous figure makes CI report the truth instead of me predicting it. Tighten to the measured number in the same change — this key should not survive it.
